_comment: One arm's own data, in its own folder. Same document the mastering file has always carried,
so a config saved from here loads through Load config and the other way round.
This is per instance and not per package on purpose: two cells using the same AR4 package
master their arms separately, and the package cannot hold both answers. The steps-per-degree
below are deliberately a hair off nominal, which is what a real mastered arm looks like.
